Microsoft Visual C++ runtime and OpenMP runtime
Copyright Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.

The Windows application contains Microsoft runtime files supplied with the
Windows distributions of Python, Qt/PySide/Shiboken, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn,
llvmlite, and PyWinRT. These components remain Microsoft Distributable Code;
they are not relicensed under the iOpenPod GPL grant.

Retain the additional Windows binary distribution conditions in the accompanying
Python-Windows-Binary-LICENSE.txt. In particular, preserve Microsoft's notices,
do not imply Microsoft's endorsement, distribute the Microsoft components only
for Microsoft platforms, and preserve the applicable Microsoft protections when
further distributing those components. These conditions apply to Microsoft's
components, not to Python, iOpenPod source, or separately licensed libraries.

The package uses the unmodified runtime DLLs supplied by those upstream Windows
distributions. Some upstream wheels give their DLL files unique names to avoid
dependency conflicts. The original component bytes and notices are retained.

Microsoft's runtime license terms and redistribution documentation:
https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files

The Windows operating system supplies the kernel and Universal CRT system
libraries. The separately rebuilt libsndfile imports those system libraries and
does not redistribute an additional Microsoft runtime.
